# How to Live Better — reading site
> A re-typeset reading site for the open-source Chinese book “How to Live Better” (eternity4719/HowToLiveBetter): 677 pieces of advice in 34 chapters, each stating what it costs, what you gain and how strong the evidence is (441 grade A, 189 grade B, 47 grade C). For anyone who wants to spend time and money where the payoff is reliable.

- Site: https://siinxu.github.io/how-to-live-better/
- Source book: https://github.com/eternity4719/HowToLiveBetter
- English translation source: https://github.com/dlgrv/HowToLiveBetter/tree/main/book/en
- Languages: en (default), zh-CN, zh-TW, ja, ko, ms, vi, fr, es, de (append ?lang=<code>)
- Reading site by Incidental AI (https://incidental.site/)
- Full text: https://siinxu.github.io/how-to-live-better/llms-full.txt
